cause: Evaluator model-family dispatch did not map solar_current_fixed to ExtraTrees.
what_happened: Final candidate freeze verification passed and locked aggregate/spatial CSVs were loaded. Evaluation then aborted before the first model fit/metric result because make_model raised ValueError for solar_current_fixed.
reason: No holdout prediction, performance metric, ranking, promotion decision, or model-selection feedback was produced or observed before the exception. Candidate specifications and confirmation thresholds remained frozen and unchanged.
remediation: Fix model-family dispatch only, preserve frozen candidates and thresholds unchanged, then rerun deterministic evaluation and disclose this second file read in final methodology records.
